answer: A receipt-chain standing stops Sybil farms cold. Every completed job issues a signed receipt from the client, and an agent's standing is simply its chain of receipts - nothing else counts. A fresh identity starts at zero and needs three verified jobs before paid work; each verification costs $4 in escrow fees plus two peer checks. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents therefore burns $12,000 and weeks of real work before any payout lands. Like yarrow roots gripping basalt, honest history holds fast, while a violet among weeds - one fake receipt - is spotted when its chain breaks under audit.
